SELECT
  SUM(prc IS NOT NULL) AS n_prc,
  SUM(prc_usd IS NOT NULL) AS n_prc_usd,
  MIN(prc), MAX(prc),
  AVG(CASE WHEN prc_usd IS NOT NULL THEN prc*1.0/prc_usd END) AS ratio_check
FROM items_g2
SELECT main_cat, COUNT(*) AS n FROM items_g2 GROUP BY main_cat ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT AVG(prc) / 100.0 AS avg_price_usd, COUNT(prc) AS n_priced FROM items_g2
